requetes.txt: SELECT c.Id, c.Statut, cl.Nom FROM dbo.Commandes c JOIN dbo.Clients cl ON cl.Id = c.ClientId WHERE c.Id = @p0
SELECT Produit, Quantite, PrixUnitaire FROM dbo.LignesCommande WHERE CommandeId = @p0
(@p0 int,@p1 datetime2)INSERT INTO dbo.Commandes (ClientId, DateCommande) VALUES (@p0, @p1)
INSERT INTO dbo.LignesCommande (CommandeId, ProduitId, Quantite) SELECT @c, p.Id, @q FROM Referentiel.dbo.Produits p WHERE p.Code = @code
UPDATE dbo.Commandes SET Statut = 'CLOTUREE' WHERE DateCommande < @d AND Statut = 'LIVREE'
UPDATE l SET PrixUnitaire = t.Prix FROM dbo.LignesCommande l JOIN Referentiel.dbo.Tarifs t ON t.ProduitId = l.ProduitId
SELECT Id, Code, Libelle FROM dbo.Produits WHERE Code = @p0
MERGE dbo.Tarifs t USING #import s ON s.ProduitId = t.ProduitId WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET Prix = s.Prix
SELECT Ligne1, CodePostal, Ville FROM dbo.Adresses WHERE ClientId = @p0
INSERT INTO fait.Ventes SELECT ... FROM Ventes.dbo.LignesCommande l JOIN Ventes.dbo.Commandes c ON c.Id = l.CommandeId
MERGE dim.Client d USING Ventes.dbo.Clients s ON s.Id = d.ClientId ...
MERGE dim.Produit d USING Referentiel.dbo.Produits s ON s.Id = d.ProduitId ...
SELECT p.Famille, c.Region, SUM(v.Montant) FROM fait.Ventes v JOIN dim.Client c ON ... JOIN dim.Produit p ON ... GROUP BY p.Famille, c.Region
INSERT INTO dbo.Documents (CommandeId, Modele) SELECT c.Id, @m FROM Ventes.dbo.Commandes c WHERE c.Statut = 'A_EDITER'
SELECT Contenu FROM dbo.Documents WHERE Id = @p0
